text:
Nora: starting thread for Sparrowhawk POC 7d POC request: customer wants to run an open 13B convo model inside their VPC + do private finetuning.
Ethan: are they comfortable with q8 variants? that'll help hit their cost targets.
Nora: they asked for cost-first recommendation but want a fallback for hallucination-sensitive flows.
Sumeet: sticky KV-cache required by product team. we should propose session-affinity rather than shared persistent cache to avoid cross-tenant leakage.
Claire: runtime note: if we do affinity, autoscaling interacts badly with cold starts. recommend a small warm pool and pre-warm script.
Ethan: propose `sparrowhawk-13b-open-q8` primary, `sparrowhawk-13b-fp16` fallback. include quant profile and kernel-validation step.
LegalBot: security checklist flagged: customer-managed KMS (CMK), SAML SSO for console, syslog to their SIEM, and contractual NDA for finetuning IP.
Nora: they also insist no telemetry leaves the VPC and model artifacts must stay local.
Sumeet: fine. we'll disable telemetry and pin the model hash. need architecture diagram from customer for KMS flow.
Claire: perf acceptance requested: p50 < 220ms for 256 tokens, p95 < 520ms. QA: human pass >= 88% vs baseline.
Ethan: warmup example to include in runbook:
```
./tools/warmup --model sparrowhawk-13b-open-q8 --seq 512 --iters 6
```
Ethan: also run `perfbench --concurrency 12 --kv-affinity` to validate tail lat.
Finance: preliminary POC cost estimate posted internally; will publish to thread once approved. short commit: 1xA10g reserved for POC window.
LegalBot: export control question surfaced  industry is regulated, need export classification. pinged legal for fast-track.
Nora: blockers: customer requires SSO before Console access and cert pinning for syslog endpoint. can infra support fixed IP egress?
InfraBot: private deployment supports static egress via NAT. need CIDR and certs. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Sumeet: ops plan: 1) provision private pool + NAT, 2) upload quant artifact + validate kernels, 3) enable session-affinity and warm pool, 4) run 100-case quality eval and perf suite.
Nora: action items: Ethan -> quant profile + perf runs, Sumeet -> affinity runbook and KV stress test, Claire -> evaluation harness and acceptance script, LegalBot -> KMS/SAML signoff, Finance -> publish estimate.
Ethan: will attach memory profile and perf logs when done.
Nora: scheduling customer sync for tomorrow 9am PT. thanks all. :rocket:
